tool_args.rationale: All five observations show positive gain at H ≤ 0.48, far short of the target H = 20.7. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the gain reverses and helps constrain the slow adaptation term before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons the slow term mainly reveals the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant. A good pilot fit would not establish the magnitude or timing of reversal.
Finer short-window sampling does not directly test reversal near the forecast horizon.
